# 禹都 AI 解决方案助手 v0.9.17

## 中文更新说明

### 技术方案与配图

- 新增 HTML 技术配图，依据章节正文和图型适用条件选择甘特图、WBS、拓扑图、组织架构图等，并插入相关段落后；生成设置和继续扩写均可控制配图。
- 增加 HTML 安全与排版检查、失败自动重试及基于正文要点的备用图，减少溢出、留白和生成失败；配图失败时保留正文。
- 继续扩写的设置仅作用于选定小节，默认目标字数改为 0；优化少量技术指标项目的自由目录生成，避免目录过于单薄。
- 改进模型连接中断后的重试与后台任务恢复。

### Word 导出与界面

- Word 导出后使用内置布局与 DOCX 结构检查预检分页、空白页、过宽图片及表格，并以清晰的分点列表展示待复核项。
- 统一常用操作按钮的视觉样式，为创建和新建操作补充图标；压缩项目列表顶部区域，优化模板管理与生成页面的工作空间。
- 数字输入允许先清空再输入，提示消息约 8 秒后自动隐藏。

### 资信库

- 支持创建多个企业并分别维护基本信息、资质、员工、业绩和图片资料。
- 增加企业删除、保存状态与手动保存操作，企业资料和图片按企业隔离。

### 发布说明

- macOS 与 Windows 安装包尚未签名，首次打开时可能出现操作系统安全提示。

---

## English Release Notes

### Technical Plans and Illustrations

- Added HTML illustrations selected from section content and chart suitability, including Gantt charts, WBS diagrams, topology diagrams, and organization charts. Charts are placed after relevant paragraphs and can be configured for full generation and continued expansion.
- Added HTML safety and layout checks, automatic retries, and a fallback diagram based on source text to reduce overflow, excess whitespace, and generation failures. Existing prose is preserved if an illustration fails.
- Limited continued-expansion settings to selected sections and changed the default target word count to zero. Improved outline generation for projects with only a few technical requirements.
- Improved retries after transient model connection failures and background-task recovery.

### Word Export and Interface

- Added built-in layout and DOCX structure checks for page breaks, blank pages, oversized images, and tables, with a clearer list of items to review.
- Refined common action buttons, added icons to create actions, reduced the project-list header area, and improved workspace layout in templates and generation pages.
- Numeric fields can be cleared before entering a new value, and toast notifications dismiss automatically after about eight seconds.

### Credential Library

- Added multiple company profiles with separate company details, certificates, employees, project records, and images.
- Added company deletion, save status, and manual save controls, with records and images isolated by company.

### Distribution Note

- macOS and Windows packages remain unsigned, so operating-system security warnings may appear on first launch.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.9.16...v0.9.17
